headline: Revenue growth accelerates as margins expand sharply
summary_short: Floor & Decor's fiscal Q2 revenue rose to $1.25B, up 3.0% y/y and 8.5% q/q, while operating income jumped 51.4% y/y to $124.0M and diluted EPS climbed to $0.89 from $0.58 a year ago.
summary_long: Revenue reached $1.25B, up 3.0% y/y and 8.5% q/q. Gross profit rose to $603.1M (+13.2% y/y, +18.9% q/q), with operating income up 51.4% y/y to $124.0M and EBITDA up 33.4% y/y to $191.9M. Net income climbed 51.7% y/y to $95.9M; diluted EPS rose to $0.89 from $0.58 y/y and $0.37 q/q. Total cash grew 81.3% y/y to $320.6M, while long-term debt was roughly flat at $195.3M.
